name: Westin Cape Coral at Marina Village
positioning: Waterfront Westin resort beside Tarpon Point Marina in Cape Coral, officially The Westin Cape Coral Resort at Marina Village, with condo-style suites and screened-in patios
best_for: Boaters and water lovers who want a marina on the doorstep
Families and longer stays needing suites with full kitchens
Travelers who want sunrise or sunset views over the water

facts.text: The spa has a couples treatment room and a Vichy shower room.
Guests can kayak, paddleboard or set out by boat from the marina.
Tarpon Point Marina, next to the resort, offers deep-water slips, transient dockage, a fuel dock and dock-and-dine access to Marina Village shops and restaurants.
A tour lets guests see dolphins in their natural surroundings.
Guests have complimentary access to outdoor clay tennis courts, bocce ball and walking and running trails at the Recreational Center.
Marker 92 Waterfront Bar & Bistro serves steaks and seafood with views of the Caloosahatchee River and Tarpon Point Marina.
The Nauti Mermaid is a waterfront restaurant with boat access.
The hotel is less than an hour's drive from Sanibel Island.
The Fill Your Fridge service lets guests pre-stock their suite with groceries before arrival.

highlights.text: Every guest room has a private screened-in patio overlooking the water, with sunrise or sunset views.
The resort has three outdoor pools with views of the Caloosahatchee River and the Gulf of Mexico.
The premier residence sits at the apex of the resort, with panoramic views over the marina, preserve and waterways.
The condo-style suites were originally built as waterfront residences and have full kitchens, living and dining areas and screened-in patios.
Esterra Spa & Salon has views of Tarpon Point Marina and the Caloosahatchee River.

considerations.text: A resort fee applies; it includes access to the Private Clubhouse.
The Private Recreation Area is a short walk from the resort.
